# Metadata and frontmatter {#metadata}

Line-1 frontmatter reads as in 0.1. New in 0.2.0, a typed `---yaml`, `---toml` or `---json` opener may start an opaque metadata block after line 1, following a blank line or top-level attribute lines; a bare `---` after line 1 stays text ([#6324](https://github.com/markup-carve/carve/issues/6324), C2-B-231 to C2-B-233). See [metadata blocks](../metadata-blocks).

**U-047** <Badge type="info" text="none" /> Format names, the space before them, unclosed frontmatter

::: compare no-render
```text
--- toml
a = 1
---
text
```
```html
<p>text</p>
```
:::

**U-048** <Badge type="info" text="none" /> Unknown format name

::: compare no-render
```text
---markdown
a = 1
---
text
```
```html
<p>text</p>
```
:::

**Specification (external):** [upgrade guide, Frontmatter](https://github.com/markup-carve/carve/blob/main/spec/0.2/UPGRADING.md#frontmatter).
